status.none: No upcoming deadlines match your filters

error.fetch: Download failed ({detail}); showing cached data if any
error.parse: Downloaded data could not be parsed
error.missing_tools: curl and jq are required to download deadlines
error.bad_url: The data URL must start with https://

tooltip.hints: Click: open panel · Right click: refresh

panel.subtitle: {count} upcoming
panel.no_starred: Star a conference to follow it here
panel.row_hint: Click for timeline, venue and acceptance rates

min_rank.label: Minimum CCF rank
min_rank.description: Show conferences at or above this CCF rank. Starred and always-shown conferences ignore this.

categories.label: Categories
categories.description: ccfddl area codes to include, e.g. AI, DB, SE, SC, NW, DS, CT, CG, HI, MX. Empty means all.

always_show.label: Always show
always_show.description: Conference names (e.g. NeurIPS) shown regardless of rank and category filters.

include_abstract.label: Count down to abstract deadlines
include_abstract.description: While a round's abstract registration is still ahead, count down to it; otherwise count down to the paper deadline. The detail view always shows both.

horizon_days.label: Look-ahead (days)
horizon_days.description: Only list deadlines within this many days.

notify_days.label: Remind before (days)
notify_days.description: Send a notification this many days before a starred deadline, and again in the last 24 hours. 0 turns reminders off.

notify_all.label: Remind for all listed
notify_all.description: Send reminders for every listed deadline, not only starred ones.

data_url.label: Data URL
data_url.description: HTTPS URL of ccfddl's aggregated allconf.json. Acceptance rates are read from allacc.json next to it.

show_text.label: Show text
show_text.description: Show the next deadline's name and countdown next to the icon. Turn off for an icon-only widget; the tooltip still lists upcoming deadlines.

display.label: Display
display.description: What the bar widget shows next to the icon.

prefer_starred.label: Prefer starred
prefer_starred.description: Show the next starred deadline in the bar; fall back to the next deadline overall.

urgent_days.label: Urgent threshold (days)
urgent_days.description: The icon turns to the error color when the deadline is this close.

refresh_days.label: Refresh interval (days)
refresh_days.description: How often to check ccfddl for new data. Unchanged data costs almost nothing to check; changed data is about 115 KB compressed.

ccf.a: CCF A: top tier in the China Computer Federation's recommended venue list
ccf.b: CCF B: second tier in the China Computer Federation's recommended venue list
ccf.c: CCF C: third tier in the China Computer Federation's recommended venue list
ccf.n: Not ranked in the China Computer Federation's recommended venue list

badge.core: CORE {rank}: rank in the Australasian CORE conference ranking (A* is the top tier, then A, B, C)
badge.abstract: Counting down to the abstract registration; the full paper is due {paper}
badge.thcpl: THCPL {rank}: rank in Tsinghua University's computer science venue list (A, then B)

detail.source_tz: Times in your local timezone; the conference lists them in {tz}.
